filter.description: Optional filter conditions to narrow results (e.g. inMailbox, from, subject).

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each object has a property name and isAscending flag. Defaults to date descending.

position.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return. Cannot be combined with anchor.

anchor.description: EmailId to use as the anchor for pagination. The page starts at this email.

anchorOffset.description: Offset in results relative to the anchor. Negative values move backwards.

limit.description: Maximum number of EmailIds to return. Defaults to server maximum.

calculateTotal.description: If true, compute the total number of matching emails (may be slower).

collapseThreads.description: If true, return only the latest email per thread, de-duplicating results.

pageToken.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous Email/query response. Pass to retrieve the next page of results. Mutually exclusive with position and anchor. See https://specs.serverlessinbox.com/page-token
